mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, name, description, archived_at, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at FROM assistant_project WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assistant_project (user_id, name, description, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{description}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE assistant_project SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
